title: Dream Police/Dream Military
content: While y'all are in your respective mall worlds, especially the ones that connect to the dorm style apartments, do you ever encounter security guards or people on duty you have to stay away from? ALSO sometimes, like last night, many of the school kids from the malls school and adults alike, had to do these workouts (running, pull ups etc) and then if we passed we would be given a piece of paper and then ordered to get on the bus. I was the only one who didn't get on the bus last night but when I asked the lady why my paper was different she said it's because I didn't get my booster shots. (The hospital is on the top floor of the mall world building). There's someone guys who live in the apt/dorm next to me, and there's a few across the courtyard when I look out the window sometimes. (There's 2 apartment buildings sometimes) ANYWAY, does anyone else experience this? Dream Military and security?
